Title: Watcher Echo Ping
Description:
[b]Last tested on game version:[/b] v1.10.1 (The Watcher)

Adds a distinctive visual and sound effect whenever entering or loading a region that has an echo present, like Saint's campaign from Downpour. Compatible with existing saves.

Full description (contains spoilers for the Watcher's progression): [spoiler]Watcher's goal is to find echoes in many different regions, just like Saint, but without any kind of details about whether or not an echo is in any given region -- and it isn't clear which ones do and don't -- there's no easy way of knowing if you should spend time scouring a given reason or if you'd be wasting your time.

Saint's campaign is also based around finding echoes and it has a preexisting effect that effectively prevents this issue entirely. I'm not sure why something like it wasn't included with Watcher's campaign, so I implemented it here.[/spoiler]

Please let me know if you run into issues! I developed this primarily for myself mid-playthrough to resolve the lack of signposting in Watcher's campaign, so I haven't extensively playtested it with dev tools.

You can find this mod's source code on [url=https://github.com/Ilysen/WatcherEchoPing]GitHub[/url], under the GPL v3 license.
